definitions.explanation: Waseda University ({早稲田大学|わせだだいがく}), one of Japan's leading private universities, founded in 1882 by {大隈重信|おおくましげのぶ}. The name also refers to the district of Shinjuku Ward where the main campus stands.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{早稲田|わせだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧だ。
examples.english: My older brother is a Waseda student.

examples.japanese: ⟦{第一志望|だいいちしぼう}→第一志望：19697_daiichishibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{早稲田|わせだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I got into Waseda, my first choice.

examples.japanese: {早稲田|わせだ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{慶応|けいおう}→慶応：31122_keiou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{早慶戦|そうけいせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{大|おお}いに→大いに：01609_ooini⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧。
examples.english: Waseda and Keio are old rivals, and the Waseda–Keio games draw huge excitement every year.

notes:
In conversation, {早稲田|わせだ} alone usually means the university.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {早稲田大学|わせだだいがく}: the full name
- {早大|そうだい}: the short form used in writing and headlines
- {早慶|そうけい}: Waseda and Keio together, the top pair of private universities
- {早慶戦|そうけいせん}: the Waseda–Keio sports rivalry, especially in baseball
